Definition: a diminutive from G1135; a little (i.e. foolish) woman:--silly woman.
BiblicalUsage: gynaikárion is a plain word for silly woman. In 2 Timothy 3:6, the text says "and lead captive silly women laden with sins."
TheologicalSignificance: For me, gynaikárion means silly woman, and I leave it at that.
RelatedTopics: Word of God; Faith; Christian Life
